Draft: island 2.2, landmark (a), tokenizer training

The concepts the landmark needs, in style B: tokenizer (new), and the line and its tokens re-drawn in style B with 2.1's grammar kept (text_line, token_bead, tokenized_line). The bank's textual_data, flag, the translated mark and flow_arrow are reused unchanged. Every concept alone at whole size (a person is 360 tall), 1/3 and 1/20; then states; then one row composing the idea.

tokenizer

The tokenizer: the model's first part, which cuts text into tokens, drawn as a small board of the model's make with a slot where a line goes in, a comb of blades over a window that cuts it, and a slot where its tokens come out. CONTAINS ['text_line', 'token_bead', 'flag']. Alone, untrained, 200 tall.

tokenizer: its three states

At the landmark's size, 130 tall, whole size.

text_line

A line of text: one sentence as a single unbroken capsule of ink, round at both ends, as long as the sentence.

token_bead

A token: one piece of a line of text, a capsule of the line's own ink, round where a word ends and cut on a clean slant, its fresh face glowing, where a blade went through a word. A whole word; a word's first piece; a piece from inside a word.

tokenized_line

A tokenized line: one line of text cut into its tokens, set in a row with a small gap between them, a wider one between words. CONTAINS ['token_bead']. Here the 9 pieces of a general tokenizer.

the line and its two outputs

The same line (top); cut into 9 pieces by a general tokenizer, CamemBERT's (inf·arc·tu·s du my·oc·arde ,); cut into 4 by TransBERT's (infarctus du myocarde ,). Round ends are a word's own ends; slanted ends, their faces sparking, are where a word was cut. Whole size, then 2×.

the idea, composed roughly

One line, split by two arrows to two tokenizers. Each is trained by its text, the bank's textual_data, arriving into its top port: general French above, TransCorpus (the translated mark) below. Each spills its tokens to the right: 9 broken pieces against 4, the medical words kept whole. Stacked rather than side by side, so the two outputs lie one above the other and are compared piece for piece, and so tokens leave each tokenizer in reading order. Whole size.

beside the family

A person (360), the bank's general_model (250, French flag), and the two trained tokenizers at the landmark's 130: one make, one light.
